problem_solved: Need to retrieve and utilize pollen from high yielding palms for breeding programmes.
description: A simple and user-friendly protocol developed at ICAR-CPCRI for the cryopreservation of coconut pollen. Pollen collected from desiccated male flowers of high yielding palms can be retrieved and utilized in breeding programmes as and when required.
applications: Commercial agricultural breeding programs, Operation of plant genetic resource banks, Deployment in crop improvement facilities
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
